messages:
Carla M: Quick sync — trying to lock a short pre-cut briefing + an RFC review slot before the cut. Need attendance + who will own the cut trigger if something fails.

Jonah K: Which cut window are we targeting? timezone?

Carla M: Targeting Thu 2026-03-19 22:00 UTC (cut window 22:00-00:00 UTC). Planning: 30m pre-cut briefing at 21:15, 15m RFC review at 21:45, 10m final go/no-go at 21:55.

Priya S: Proposed agenda (copy if helpful):
```
21:15 - 21:45 Pre-cut briefing
 - roll call (owners + backups)
 - known risks & mitigations
 - infra capacity check
21:45 - 22:00 RFC/design quick review (only blockers)
22:00 - 22:10 Final go/no-go and cut trigger owner confirm
```

Priya S: Also add a canary smoke checklist (happy path + perf) and a rollback stanza.

Marco R: I can own the cut trigger and immediate rollback if the canary fails. @Lila T can you be backup?

Lila T: Yes, I can be backup. I'll also run the smoke checklist and monitor metrics during canary.

Jonah K: Note: infra maintenance is scheduled Wed 16:00-18:00 UTC, so Thu is clear. @ops-bot FYI.

ops-bot: Reminder: infra maintenance window Wed 2026-03-18 16:00-18:00 UTC (already noted). No conflicts detected for Thu 22:00 UTC.

Carla M: Need product presence for final go/no-go and to confirm feature flags. @Priya S can you confirm product rep?

Priya S: I’ll represent product for the final decision. Will prepare a short signoff checklist: feature flags, customer comms, data migrations.

Marco R: Who owns the RFC review? I can do high-level pass, but need one of the design authors to be present for questions.

Carla M: @Jonah K can you ask the RFC authors to join the 21:45 slot? If any author can't make it, we do async notes and only discuss blockers.

Jonah K: Will ping authors now.

Carla M: Quick roster so far:
 - Marco R (cut trigger)
 - Lila T (canary backup + smoke)
 - Priya S (product signoff)
 - Jonah K (RFC coordination)
 - Carla M (release owner)

Carla M: Open asks: please react with :white_check_mark: for a yes (able to attend), :x: if not, or add a time suggestion. If you can only do async, add "async" next to your name.

Marco R: :white_check_mark:

Lila T: :white_check_mark:

Priya S: :white_check_mark:

Jonah K: :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Heads up — deploy pipeline gate names are release-preflight, canary-smoke, and release-cut. Make sure branch protections are green prior to preflight.

Carla M: Thanks. If anyone else needs to be added (security, compliance, analytics), call them out here. Otherwise I'll send the calendar invites with the agenda + checklist by EOD.

Lila T: Can we add a short test-run earlier in the day for the canary script? Maybe 17:00 UTC quick dry-run so we catch config issues.

Carla M: Good idea — 17:00 dry-run. I'll add it as optional.

Jonah K: Pinged RFC authors — one author (Sam) is timezone-constrained but will drop async notes. Others confirmed.

Carla M: Perfect. I'll assemble the final agenda and the ownership table and post it here once invites go out. Thanks all :party_parrot:
